message:
The yen receipt now reads `Paid ¥500 by card`, and all 18 tests pass.

`formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js` always divides by 100, so 500 yen came out as ¥5.00. I fixed it in `src/payments/receipt.js` by formatting JPY amounts as whole units there. Other currencies still go through `formatMoney`.

I left `src/utils/money.js` alone because your fence limits this task to `src/payments`. The same bug probably affects other callers of `formatMoney` (invoices, cart, admin), and fixing it there would cover them too. Say so if you want me to widen the scope.

My first attempt, a shell heredoc, was blocked by the Fenceline hook, which misread the word "Paid" in the text as a protected path. The file I was writing was inside the allowed area, so I made the same change with the Edit tool.
